content:
Last weekend, Apple TV made a number of announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including the premiere date for the fourth season of "Silo" ("活地"), which came as quite a surprise.

"Silo" Season 4 will premiere in the summer of 2027 and will be the show's final season.

"Silo" Season 3 is currently streaming (you can watch it here), with new episodes released weekly until September 4.

However, at San Diego Comic-Con last weekend, in addition to announcing news about other sci-fi series, Apple also brought an unexpected surprise for "Silo" fans.

"Silo" Season 4 will begin airing next summer and will bring the entire story to a close.

Below is the announcement posted by Apple TV on platform X:

In the streaming era, it often takes years between seasons of a single series. For high-budget sci-fi productions like "Silo," this is especially common.

Nonetheless, Apple has been actively greenlighting some of its series ahead of schedule to accelerate their return. In the case of "Silo," Seasons 3 and 4 were actually developed simultaneously and filmed back-to-back.

We still have six more weeks of new episodes to watch. But after this season wraps up, the wait for Season 4 won't be too long.

How do you feel about "Silo" Season 3 so far? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is US$12.99, and you can enjoy a discounted rate through the Apple One bundle.
